contentHtml:
Your work permit number is what opens so many doors to opportunities in the UAE job market. That combination of digits is necessary for paperwork, approvals, salaries, job changes, and basically your entire working life in the country. It matters far more than most people realize.

In this blog post, we discuss everything you should know about your work permit number.

Why This Number Deserves Your Full Attention

What is a work permit number in UAE? Essentially, it is that one  code that ties your work and residency visa process together.
Your work permit is the first official document that permits you to earn an income in the UAE. The number attached to it is the unique identifier the government uses to track your employment details, your status, and every update your employer submits.

You receive your work permit number at the time your employer applies for your initial approval. The moment the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) issues your permit, the number becomes your reference point for every future update or renewal. Employers use it, government portals use it, and sooner or later you will probably need it too, especially when you are checking your status online or switching jobs.

Why Does Your Work Permit Number Matters So Much?

Your work permit in UAE connects your employment contract, your labor card, your company’s quota, and yes, the visa stamping process too. Without it, you cannot move ahead with your work and residency visa even if every other document is ready.

You can use the number whenever you want to check your permit’s validity online. Use it during job transitions, use it to verify your employer actually applied for your permit.

We see too many employees stuck because they simply didn’t know where their number was or how to verify it.

Where Can You Find Your UAE Work Permit Number?

You can find your UAE work permit number listed on your work permit itself after it is issued. Or if you have access to your company’s PRO or HR team, they can share it with you too.

Many people also find it inside the MOHRE app or through their Emirates ID once their visa is completed. If you have switched jobs in the past, always confirm you are using the most recent number because old permits get canceled when you change employers.

How the Work Permit Number Supports Your Visa

Your permit number ties directly into your visa application. This means the moment your employer applies for your entry permit or residency, the government links everything using this number. Without it, no approvals move forward.

This system keeps your employment history organized. When you apply for a job change later or update your details in MOHRE, the number connects every record. It also helps you check if your status shows as active, canceled, or under process. If anything looks off, you have the right to raise it with your employer or ask our team to verify it for you.

Common Problems People Face

We help hundreds of clients every month and there are patterns we see repeatedly. People often struggle to find their number or misunderstand how it works. Some discover their employer never processed their permit properly. Others realize they have multiple permits from older jobs that need cancellation.

Start by verifying your number through official channels. If you have doubts, get your permit checked by someone who actually works with UAE government systems. Our PRO team handles this daily for clients, especially when they are changing jobs or applying for a new visa.

How Your Work Permit Number Helps During Job Change

When you switch employers, your future company needs to confirm your previous permit is canceled. Your current work permit number helps them check this. If your old employer delays the cancellation, you can use your number to confirm the status and follow up appropriately.

When candidates skip this step, their new company cannot complete the hiring process. We always recommend verifying your cancellation status early. It prevents delays, protects your rights, and helps you avoid back-and-forth emails that go nowhere.

How To Use Your Number For Status Checks

You can check your permit’s status on the MOHRE website or app using the number. Or you get access to your validity, your company’s details, and sometimes your contract. This gives you more control over your employment information.

If something seems inaccurate, get in touch with us. Our team helps employees raise corrections, manage permit updates, or follow up with employers when needed. You deserve accuracy in your records because errors can affect future renewals or visa applications.

Why Companies Must Keep Your Permit Updated

Employers are responsible for keeping your permit active and updated. This includes renewing it on time, updating your profession, and canceling it when you leave. The permit number allows them to do all of this smoothly.

How Work Permit Numbers Support Employees

When you understand your permit number, you understand your employment rights. You know your status. You know whether your employer processed your documents correctly. And you know what to do next when something looks unusual.

UAE values transparency and proper documentation. Knowing your work permit number empowers you to stay on top of your records, especially if you plan to grow your career here or pursue long-term residency options later.

When You Should Reach Out For PRO Services

You might not need support for simple status checks. But if you are facing delays, job changes, lost paperwork, or mismatched records, a professional PRO team can save you time.

How KPM PRO Supports Employers

We manage these tasks for companies that want to avoid delays and mistakes. We coordinate with MOHRE, handle documentation, and keep everything compliant so the business can focus on operations. If your company needs experienced PRO assistance, we handle work permit applications, renewals, cancellations, corrections, and MOHRE follow-ups. If you want your permit processed correctly without roadblocks, we assist with the full cycle.

Conclusion

At first glance, your work permit number might seem like a tiny administrative detail. But it actually impacts your entire working experience in the UAE. You can avoid delays, confusion, and costly mistakes when you know what it represents and how you should use it.

If you want support with your UAE work permit number, your work and residency visa, or any PRO requirement, our team is here to assist you. Get in touch with us for our services.

FAQs:

What is a work permit number in the UAE?

A work permit number in the UAE is a unique reference number issued by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) for every approved employment permit. It helps track an employee’s legal work status in the UAE.

Why is the work permit number important in the UAE?

The work permit number confirms that an employee is legally authorized to work in the UAE. It is required for visa processing, labor contract verification, salary payments through WPS, and compliance with UAE labor laws.

Where can I find my UAE work permit number?

You can find your work permit number on your work permit approval document, labor contract, MOHRE approval letter, or through the MOHRE online portal and mobile app.

Who issues the work permit number in the UAE?

The work permit number is issued by MOHRE for mainland companies. For free zone companies, the respective free zone authority issues the employment permit number.

Is the work permit number the same as the visa number?

No, the work permit number and visa number are different. The work permit number relates to employment approval, while the visa number is linked to residency and immigration records.
